overlap_review.screened_obstacles: Union of all retained r58 tracks/vias/pads and every added primitive from the exact conditional r59 USB transaction; conservative retained source USB geometry is also included. Neither USB file nor source was modified.

return_power_implications: The 3V3 donor retains 0.25 mm width, B.Cu routing, original external ports and its complete connected branch. There are no power-layer changes or added power vias.
The U1.12-to-C11.2 GND donor remains 0.127 mm on B.Cu and preserves every source branch/pad contact through a physically connected replacement. No GND via is removed.

The existing VX_SENSE via is shifted 0.060 mm right, retains ordinary 0.45/0.20 mm through-via construction and F.Cu/B.Cu connections. Its formerly incidental F.Cu overlaps are preserved as explicit connected paths through the replacement F.Cu donor and the unchanged shared junction.
The main VX_SENSE three-segment donor becomes segment/arc/segment at the same 0.127 mm width on F.Cu, with no new via or layer transition. The fixed A_RX and B_TX vias and U13.4 pad are not edited.

A shifted signal-via antipad will change local filled reference-plane geometry. Fresh refill must establish that In1/In4 GND main components, local return-via contacts and pad thermal paths remain intact. Screening does not claim post-refill continuity or impedance qualification.
acceptance_gates: Apply only after verifying the source SHA and every exact removal block. Rebase explicitly if a different source is adopted.

Run KiCad 10.0.7 native refill, all-track-errors, schematic parity and DRC in the assigned sole native lane. Require target violations removed, no new clearance/short/open/hole/edge/paste findings, and unchanged schematic and architecture.
Verify exact added arc is realized by PCB_ARC, all original external ports remain full-width contacts, and all other source copper and physical ports remain unchanged.
For the shifted VX_SENSE via, verify drill-to-copper, drill/paste exclusion, finite annular branch contact and native plane/refill return preservation.
Preserve original power widths and layers; check local ground/thermal return connectivity and conditional USB compatibility on the final adopted board.
